forWhomConvenience.title: When laser hair removal makes life easier
forWhomConvenience.description: Laser hair removal is about more than smooth skin: less shaving, less irritation, more freedom. Six situations where it really helps.

forWhomIrritation.title: Irritation after shaving
forWhomIrritation.description: Red bumps, itching, nicks and ingrown hairs after shaving? Laser hair removal reduces hair growth for the long term and spares your skin.

forWhomShaving.title: Tired of shaving all the time
forWhomShaving.description: Shaving your legs, armpits, bikini line or face every few days? After a course of laser hair removal, looking after yourself gets simpler.

forWhomBeard.title: A sharp beard outline
forWhomBeard.description: The laser removes hair above the beard line and on the neck, so a sharp beard outline lasts longer without constant touch-ups.

article.intro: Laser hair removal is not just about smooth skin. For many people it is a way to stop shaving all the time, stop fighting irritation and stop planning their life around hair removal.
article.outro: If you recognise yourself in even one of these situations, we will help you choose the right areas and put together a personal treatment plan.

irritation.title: Shaving ends in irritation every time
irritation.body: Red bumps, itching, nicks and ingrown hairs keep coming back — especially on the neck, in the armpits and in the bikini area. Laser hair removal reduces hair growth for the long term, so the razor irritates your skin far less often.

shaving.title: You are tired of shaving all the time
shaving.body: Legs, armpits, bikini line, face or neck need shaving every few days, sometimes every morning. It eats time and turns into an endless routine. After a course of laser hair removal, looking after yourself gets much simpler.

beard.title: You have a beard, but its outline needs constant touching up
beard.body: Hair above the beard line or on the neck quickly spoils a neat look. You end up shaving the edges yourself or having them fixed at the barber's again and again. The laser removes hair outside the shape you choose, so a sharp beard outline lasts much longer.

face.title: Unwanted facial hair needs constant attention
face.body: Hair above the upper lip or on the chin has to be plucked, shaved and checked every time you look in the mirror. It stands out most in bright light. Laser hair removal reduces the growth, so you no longer have to deal with it every few days.

hardToReach.title: Hair grows where it is hard to remove yourself
hardToReach.body: The back, the shoulders or the back of the neck are hard to shave properly without help. What is left is regular waxing appointments or simply putting up with the unwanted hair. Laser hair removal reduces growth for the long term and makes hard-to-reach areas easy to look after.

ready.title: You want to be ready for a holiday, the pool or a date without a last-minute shave
ready.body: A trip, a workout, the sauna, the pool or an unexpected date shouldn't start with the thought “I need to shave first”. Laser hair removal gives you more freedom — you can choose your clothes and make plans without constant preparation.

technology.title: Diode laser and IPL for smooth skin
technology.imageAlt: Diode laser device in the treatment room
technology.lead: At elcorix we choose the technology and settings to suit your skin and hair. We work with the modern ALIX TWIN diode laser and with IPL — with a cooling system and professional settings for different body zones.
technology.consultationFirst: First a consultation and skin assessment — then the right treatment.

more.title: Modern laser and IPL technology for your skin
more.intro: At elcorix we use modern technology for the professional removal of unwanted hair — the ALIX TWIN AI Smart 5000 8W diode laser and IPL.

laser.title: The ALIX TWIN diode laser
laser.p1: ALIX TWIN works with four wavelengths — 755, 808, 940 and 1064 nm. This lets the parameters be adapted to different skin types and to the colour and structure of the hair.
laser.checksIntro: Before the treatment, the specialist takes into account:
checks: the colour, thickness and density of your hair
how your skin reacts during the treatment
laser.p2: An intelligent analysis system helps assess the characteristics of your skin and hair, and the specialist uses that data to choose the right treatment parameters.
laser.p3: The powerful Alix Freezing cooling system reduces heating of the skin and makes the treatment considerably more comfortable. Depending on the zone and the chosen settings, the handpiece can be cooled to as low as −26 °C.
laser.p4: Interchangeable tips make it possible to treat small zones, such as the face and underarms, as well as large areas of the body.

ipl.title: IPL — light technology for specific concerns
ipl.p1: IPL is not a laser but intense pulsed light across a broad spectrum. It can be used for certain cosmetic treatments related to unwanted hair and the condition of the skin.
ipl.checksIntro: IPL is not suitable for every client or every zone. Before the treatment, the specialist assesses:
ipl.p2: After the consultation we choose the most suitable technology — diode laser or IPL. In some cases the laser works more precisely; in others IPL may be the right option.

facts.title: What you should know
facts.p1: Neither laser nor IPL guarantees that all hair will be gone after a single treatment. Hairs are in different growth phases, so a course of treatments is usually needed.
facts.sessionsIntro: The number of sessions depends on:
facts.explainIntro: Before your first treatment we explain:
explain: how many treatments you are likely to need
what to avoid before and after the treatment
what results you can realistically expect

more.disclaimer: Treatments are carried out for cosmetic purposes. Before using IPL, the specialist checks whether the technology is suitable for you individually and whether there are any contraindications.

specialist.title: Who treats you
specialist.imageAlt: Elena, specialist for professional laser hair removal
specialist.p1: I'm Elena, and at elcorix I do one thing: laser hair removal.
specialist.p2: Before the first pulse we sit down and talk. I look at your skin and hair and ask about medication, sun and anything that could rule a treatment out. If the laser isn't right for you, I'll tell you straight.
specialist.p3: Then I set the device for you: skin type, hair thickness, zone. A test pulse shows how your skin reacts before we treat the whole area.
specialist.p4: After every session you get clear aftercare instructions. Questions between appointments are always welcome.

pain.question: Does laser hair removal hurt?
pain.answer: The handpiece is cooled to as low as −26 °C, which makes the treatment much more comfortable. Before the first treatment, a test pulse on a small spot shows how your skin reacts — so you know what it feels like before we start.

sessions.question: How many sessions will I need?
sessions.answer: That depends on your skin type, hair thickness and the zone. We give you a realistic number in the free consultation, together with the total cost. For a course of treatment there are packages of 6 or 8 sessions.

interval.question: How long is the gap between two sessions?
interval.answer: We set the interval individually — by zone, hair growth, skin reaction, season and the result of the previous session.

skinTypes.question: Will the laser work on my skin and hair type?
skinTypes.answer: The device works with four wavelengths (755, 808, 940 and 1064 nm), and an AI scanner measures skin type, hair colour and hair density. That lets us treat a range of skin and hair types. Whether it will work for you is something we check in the consultation — and if it will not, we tell you plainly.

preparation.question: What should I do before my appointment?
preparation.answer: You will get preparation instructions from us before the appointment. Please tell us in advance if you take medication, have had a lot of sun, are pregnant or have any skin changes — we check these before every treatment.

consultation.question: Is the consultation really free?
consultation.answer: Yes. The first consultation with a test pulse is free and without obligation. We look at your skin and hair, check whether the laser suits you and tell you how many sessions are realistic.

pricing.question: Is the price per session?
pricing.answer: Yes, all prices are per session and per zone, and they are final prices — no VAT is shown under § 19 UStG (small-business scheme). Zones can be combined; we are happy to put a package together for you.

packages.question: How do the packages work?
packages.answer: A package covers 6 or 8 treatments of the zones you choose at a lower price per treatment — you save up to 30 %. It is paid in advance and is valid for twelve months from payment. The details are in the package terms.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel or move an appointment?
cancellation.answer: Yes — please at least 24 hours in advance. What applies to short-notice cancellations is set out in the appointment terms.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.intro: elcorix stands for permanent hair removal that feels safe, honest and comfortable. Three things matter most to us.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.body: Every treatment starts with an analysis of your skin and hair type and a patch test. We work to documented protocols, with single-use materials and tested equipment — and we say so openly when a treatment is not suitable.

honesty.title: Honest advice
honesty.body: We do not promise results we cannot deliver. You will know in advance how many sessions are realistically needed, what that costs and what the alternatives are — with no sales pressure.

care.title: Time for you
care.body: We schedule enough time per appointment so you can settle in, ask questions and feel well looked after from start to finish.
